app.name: Courier
app.description: A two-sided matchmaking product for people, teams, companies, and project opportunities.

talent.label: Talent side
talent.heroTitle: People discover teams, projects, and paid work through talent.
talent.heroText: Courier helps people profit from their abilities by finding teams, projects, and companies that need exactly what they can contribute.
talent.deckHeading: Teams, projects, and opportunities matched to a contributor.
talent.deckCaption: People swipe through team and opportunity cards that fit their preferences.

viewer.name: Mina Sol
viewer.summary: A multidisciplinary designer looking for remote or hybrid creative teams, paid opportunities, and mission-driven projects where strong product taste matters.

flow: Swipe left to reject a team, project, or opportunity.
Swipe right to save something worth pursuing.
After saving, you can reach out directly.
If both sides save each other, Courier creates a match.

cards.name: Signal House
cards.shortDescription: A small team building a writing-led mystery game and looking for a designer who can help the world feel intentional and memorable.
cards.openTo: Design contributors who like mood-heavy game projects

cards.name: Looking for OST
cards.shortDescription: A narrative game project searching for an original soundtrack partner early enough to shape the emotional voice of the world.
cards.openTo: People who can shape music direction alongside the team

cards.name: Frontend Partner Wanted
cards.shortDescription: A company with backend systems already live needs a frontend collaborator to turn the product into a polished, launchable experience.

team.label: Team side
team.heroTitle: Teams and companies discover people who can move projects forward.
team.heroText: Courier helps teams, projects, and companies find contributors who want to profit from their talents and who fit the needs of the work.
team.deckHeading: People matched to the needs of a team or company.
team.deckCaption: Teams swipe through contributor profiles that fit what they need right now.

viewer.name: Noor Studio
viewer.summary: A small creative company looking for people who can contribute consistently across design, audio, and frontend work on collaborative product efforts.

flow: Swipe left to reject a contributor profile.
Swipe right to save someone your team wants to pursue.
Saved profiles can be contacted directly.
Mutual saves turn the connection into a match.

cards.name: Ari Kline
cards.shortDescription: Composer and sound designer focused on games, interactive storytelling, and emotionally memorable audio systems.
cards.openTo: Narrative games, prototypes, and remote teams

cards.name: Jules Mercer
cards.shortDescription: Frontend engineer with strong product taste who likes community tools, dashboard experiences, and small teams with real momentum.
cards.openTo: Teams building creator, music, or community products

cards.name: Mina Sol
cards.shortDescription: Product designer who likes making early-stage tools feel calm, playful, and easy to trust.
cards.openTo: Mission-driven teams and web product builds
